tei:div.tei:p: ༈ chos kyi sdom bzhi ston pa dri ma med pa'i gtam bzhugs/

chos kyi sdom bzhi dri ma med pa'i gtam/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs pa'i yon tan dam pas rab brgyan zhing*/ /nyes pa'i chu gter kun las 'das pa'i mthar/ /don gnyis mdzad pa'i phrin las rab rdzogs nas/ /mya ngan 'da' ston de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji ltar 'phags pa ba glang bdag bzhin du/ /chos kyi sdom bzhi rab tu dbye ba yis/ /'dus pa'i tshogs la snying nas bskul ba'i tshig /snyan pa'i bka' mchid lags kyis gsan par zhu/ /rab dkar dge tshogs 'od zer stong 'phro zhing*/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'byor pa'i snying po can/ /dal 'byor rin chen pho brang chen po nas/ /dad ldan skye bo rnams la legs smras pa/ /'di ltar nor 'dzin dag na snang ba yi/ /phun tshogs de yang brtan pa ma yin la/ /skyes pa 'chi zhing 'dus pa 'bral bas na/ /mi rtag skyo shas blo sna thung bar mdzod/ /'gro drug nang nas mi yi lus rnyed dkon/ /de bas dam pa rnams dang 'phrad pa dkon/ /de bas chos thob pa dang spyod pa dkon/ /de bas zab don snying po'i don mthong dkon/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka'i gru chen thob dus 'dir/ /rab zab bla ma'i man ngag gru gzengs kyis/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho brgal la brtson par mdzod/ /ring por mi thogs byang chub mchog sangs rgyas/ /gal te le los thar lam ma snyogs na/ /phyis nas gar 'gro bdag gis ji ltar shes/ /de dus bcos su yod pa ma lags kyi/ /da lta nyid du brtson pa'i stobs skyed cig /bdag cag tshe ni g.yo ba'i sprin dang 'dra/ / lus ni g.yar po bzhin te ltos med la/ /'chi bdag mi sdod nub ri'i grib ma 'dra/ /skad cig mi sdod 'jig pa'i chos can du/ /de ring nyid nas nges par rtogs par mdzod/ /kye ma grogs dag deng nas ma 'bad na/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba nub tshe ji ltar bya/ /cha med yul der rgyus med 'gro dus na/ /gcig pu grogs med skyabs dang mgon med la/

/gnyen dang bshes med sus kyang phan par med/ /de dus rang snang bag chags dge sdig 'brang*/ /sngar bsags las kyis phyi ma'i snang ba 'char/ /sus kyang bsgyur med dge sdig 'bras bu myong*/ /de bas da lta dge la brtson par mdzod/ /ji ltar nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog bzhin/ /bdag cag tshe 'gro nam yang yid brtan med/ /deng 'chi sang 'chi nges pa ma mchis pas/ /da lta nyid du chos la brtson par rigs/ /snying po med pa'i lus 'di 'jig cing 'dor/ /skyes pa'i tha ma yin te 'chi bas na/ /dal zhing 'byor pas brgyan pa'i tshe 'di la/ /thar pa'i lam bzang snyegs la brtson par mdzod/ /da lta'i sa steng 'gro ba 'di dag kyang*/ /lo brgya'i nang du lus pa 'ga' med la/ /glo bur nad rkyen tshe la nges med pas/ /snying nas mi rtag 'chi ba bsam par rigs/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' dpag yas shing*/ /'chi bas 'jig pa'i skye ba pha mtha' yas/ /gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal chu bzhis rtsen/ /de las thar phyin brtson pa'i stobs skyed cig /tshe 'di sprin dang 'dra ste mi brtan g.yo/ /lus ni lbu ba 'dra ste 'jig tu nye/ /'dir tshogs mgron po 'dra ste 'gyes la khad/ /thams cad rmi lam 'dra ste snying po med/ /'dus byas chos la yid brtan 'ga' med pas/ /brtson pa'i sems kyis snying po'i don sgoms shig /tshe 'di rmi lam sgyu ma'i snang ba la/ /mi mkhas bden par bzung bas byis pa 'khrul/ /sprul pas 'gro ba bslu zhes rtogs byas nas/ /snying po'i don la deng nas brtson par rigs/ /dal 'byor snying po ldan pa'i lus 'di yang*/ /mi rtag myur 'gro nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dra/ /'chi bdag mi sdod nub ri'i grib ma bzhin/ /'jig rten phyi ma'i snang ba 'char du nye/ /grogs dag rtag 'dzin le lo'i sems bor la/ /de ring nyid nas dam pa'i chos mdzod cig /bdag ni mal gyi tha ma der 'dug nas/ / 'chi ba'i dus babs 'byung bzhi'i bsdu tshul dang*/

/bar do'i snang ba sna tshogs shar ba'i tshe/ /nor dang gnyen bshes sgyu ma'i grogs la sogs/ / 'jig rten chos kyis stongs pa'i skabs med na/ /bdag gis ci bya de dus su la re/ /de bas da lta dam pa'i chos mdzod cig /gang du phyin nas slar log mi 'gyur ba/ /'chi bdag khyim der bdag cag 'gro dgos na/ /'jigs bral nyag gcig skyabs dang dpung gnyen mchog /'di phyir phan pa dam pa'i chos las med/ /snying nas 'chi ba bsams te chos mdzod cig /mdor na 'bab chu gya gyur ltung ba dang*/ /nub ri'i grib ma mi sdod 'ong ba dang*/ /nyin mtshan skad cig thang gcig 'gyur ba'i dpes/ /tshe la long med 'chi ba dran byas la/ /de ring nyid nas chos la brtson par mdzod/ /de ring mi rtag sang du 'gyur bas kyang*/ /rang gi tshe 'gro skad cig g.yo ba ste/ /nges par 'chi zhes gting nas dran bya zhing*/ /tshe la long med blo sna bstung byas la/ /da lta nyid du dam pa'i chos mdzod cig /nam yang bde med 'khor ba sbrul gdug gling*/ /rgyal po'i btson ra 'dra bar rtogs nas ni/ /sems nyid don la goms pa'i dbang 'byor bas/ /gdod ma'i zad sar gtan srid zin par mdzod/ /grogs dag gcig tu dge la brtson pa dang*/ /thos pa'i don bzhin nyams su lon pa yis/ /'chi ba'i tshe na mi 'jigs gdeng dang ldan/ /spro dga'i sems kyis gtan srid zin par mdzod/ /grogs dag skyes pa gang yin 'chi ba ste/ /sang dang bdag gi tshe zad dus 'di gnyis/ /sngon la gang 'byung nges pa med do zhes/ /snying nas bsams te rtag tu chos mdzod cig /ri bdun gling bzhi thal bar mi lus shing*/ /dus mtha'i rlung gis stong pa'i skabs yod la/ / 'gro kun mi rtag sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du/ /nam zhig 'gyur zhes nges par rtogs byas nas/ /snying nas zhi ba'i chos la brtson par mdzod/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor thob kyang mi rtag la/ /lhan cig 'dus pa'i grogs kyang 'bral bas na/

/tshe 'dir ma chags phyi ma rgyun ring bas/ /da lta nyid du dam pa'i chos mdzod cig /tshangs dang bde 'byung 'jig rten dbang po'i dgra/ /drag po tha skar nyin mor byed rnams kyang*/ /'chi bdag gnas las thar ba'i skabs med la/ /yid 'ong rdo rje'i sku yang mi rtag na/ /lbu ba rdol 'dra lus 'di cis mi 'jig /des kyang gcig tu brtson pa'i stobs bskyed la/ /mi rtag 'chi ba bsams nas chos mdzod cig /'dus byas mi rtag pa'i tshoms te dang po'o// //dge legs snyan pa'i pho brang chen po nas/ /dad ldan skye bo rnams la yang smras pa/ /zag bcas chos rnams ring bzhin sdug bsngal te/ /sdug bsngal 'gyur dang 'du byed sdug bsngal gsum/ /snod bcud srid gsum bde ba'i go skabs med/ /sems dmyal yi dwags byol song lha min dang*/ /lhar bcas mi yi 'jig rten ma lus kun/ /dge sdig las kyis zo chu'i khyud mo 'dra/ /mtho ris thob kyang ngan 'gror ltung bas na/ /'khor ba'i grong nas thar pa'i thabs 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin sdig la goms pa'i rgyu 'bras can/ /rang snang log pas dmyal ba'i 'jig rten na/ /dus mtha'i me chen 'bar bas ches lhag pas/ /las kyi me lce gcig tu gyur pa yis/ /phyi nang lus kyi sha kun tshig gyur la/ /gshin rje'i skyes bus drag tu gzir ba las/ /mi bzod mtshon dang brag ris sdug bsngal zhing*/ /kha cig lcags kyi khang par bsregs gyur la/ /tho lum 'bar bas lus nang zhugs gyur cing*/ /la la lcags kyi bye tshan 'bar ba dang*/ /khro chu khol mas mi bzad sdug bsngal lo/ /gzhan dag 'bar ba'i gsal shing rtser 'dug cing*/ /khrag dang zhag gis sa phyogs khyab par byed/ /kha cig thig nag bsdus 'joms ngu 'bod cing*/ /ngu 'bod che dang tsha bas rab tsha zhing*/ /la la mnar med lcags khyim 'bar ba ru/ /lus po brgyangs pa lcags kyi phur bus 'debs/ kha cig me yi tho bas 'joms byed cing*/

/spu gri'i lam sogs mtshon gyis sdug bsngal lo/ /la la thal tshan chu bor bying gyur cing*/ /'dab bzang mchu yis klad pa 'gems par byed/ /la la zangs chen khol mar 'tshod byed cing*/ /tsha ba'i sdug bsngal shin tu mi bzad do/ /la la mtshon cha'i ri la sha kun 'thor/ /mdag me 'bar bas yun ring sdug bsngal lo/ /de bzhin grang bas nyam thag sems dmyal yang*/ /chu bur can dang chu bur rdol ba can/ /a chu kyi hud so tham padma can/ /padma che ltar gas pas sdug bsngal zhing*/ /bu yug langs pas rab tu sbrebs gyur la/ /shin tu nyam thag sdug bsngal pha mtha' yas/ / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dag na'ang bde ba med/ /bkres skom me chen 'bar bas lus gdung yang*/ /bar gyi bskal bar zas skom sgra mi thos/ /sos ka'i zla ba bsil ba'i 'od zer kyang*/ /me lce 'bar bas rab tu tsha ba bzhin/ / dgun rnams nyi ma bsil bas gdung bar byed/ /sman shing me tog chu klung bzang po yang*/ /mthong bas skam la rnag khrag nyid du 'bab/ /lto ba yangs shing rkang lag shin tu phra/ /zas skom mi chud chud na'ang 'bar ba'i mes/ /glo snying bsreg cing me lce'i char 'bab bo/ kha cig las kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu che yang*/ / kun tu 'khyams shing gnod pa'i sbyor ba can/ /nad gtong mdangs 'phrog tshe la bar du gcod/ /ngan song nyid las thar ba'i skabs med do/ /de nas byol song dag gi 'jig rten na/ /glen zhing gti mug gcig gis gcig za zhing*/ /bsad bcad dag dang bkol spyod las kyis mnar/ /bkres skom nad dang 'tshe ba'i 'jigs pas nyen/ /mi rnams la yang bde ba'i skabs med de/ /skye rga na 'chi 'thab rtsod dbul phongs dang*/ /'dod pas mi ngoms bsags dang bsrung la sogs/ / byams pa'i gnyen bral dgra dang phrad par dogs/ /'tshol skyong 'tshe dang yid mi bde ba dang*/ /'dod pa ma grub mi 'dod thog tu 'bab/ /sna tshogs sdug bsngal mang pos so sor mnar/

/lha min 'thab rtsod du mas sdug bsngal te/ /g.yul ngor shing rta chag dang rnam par dkrugs/ /ri rab 'phangs pas non pas lus 'dar zhing*/ /rgya mtsho 'khrugs pas 'chol ba'i sgra skad dang*/ /brag ri nyil bas stong gsum g.yo ba bzhin/ /mtshon cha'i 'khor los rdul phran bzhin du bcom/ /dus mtha'i me rlung 'khrugs las 'thor ba bzhin/ /snying yang 'gas pas gson du re ba med/ /zhe sdang drag pos rang gi sems bsreg cing*/ /'thab rtsod drag pos phyi rol rnam par 'gyur//de bzhin rang gi sde yang rab tu 'khrug /rgyun du rtsod pas bde ba'i skabs med do/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang sum cu rtsa gsum na'ang*/ /bag med 'dod pas g.yengs shing mi dag la/ /lha min 'tshe zhing g.yul ngor sdug bsngal lo/ /bde mang spyad kyang rmi lam sad pa ltar/ /'chi ba'i tshe na yun thung ngoms pa med/ /me tog nyams dang rnying la nyams mi dga'/ /phyi ma'i gnas mthong lus la dri mi zhim/ /grogs kyis spong dang 'du shes 'khrugs pa ste/ /lha yi zhag bdun bar du sdug bsngal ba/ /ngan song sdug bsngal las kyang ches lhag go /mtshe ma dga' ldan 'phrul dga' gzhan 'phrul byed/ /'dod pas mi ngoms bag med lhung ba ste/ /slar yang ngan song gnas su 'bab 'tshal lo/ /tshangs ris la sogs bsam gtan gnas bcu gnyis/ /bsam gtan bde bas snga ma'i gnas zad de/ /slar yang ngan song dag tu lhung 'gyur zhing*/ /gzugs med bzhi yang zhi gnas gcig gis ni/ /bskal pa la gnas de yang las zad tshe/ /ngan 'gro'i gnas su 'jug par thub pas gsungs/ /mdor na khams gsum 'khor ba'i grong khyer na/ /sdug bsngal nyid gsum brgyad kyis sdug bsngal zhing*/ / bde ba'i skabs med me yi 'obs dang 'dra/ /da res tshe 'dir srid mtsho ma brgal na/ /phyi nas cir 'gyur bdag gis ji ltar bya/ /de bas 'khor ba'i rang bzhin sdug bsngal la/ /snying nas skyo bas rang gzhan thar bya'i phyir/ /de ring nyid nas nges par 'bad par bya/

/da lta'i tsha grang bkres skom cung zad la'ang*/ /bdag gis mi bzod smre sngags 'byin byed na/ /'khor ba ngan song sdug bsngal mi bzad pa/ /drag la rgyun ring bdag gis ji ltar bzod/ /de bas chos la dka' thub gus mdzod la/ /dad dang ngo tsha khrel yod shes pa dang*/ / byams dang snying rje byang chub sems chen pos/ /srid pa'i chu gter brgal la brtson par mdzod/ /deng nas bdag gis brtson par ma byas na/ /tshe rabs gzhan du bde 'gro'ang mi thob na/ /byang chub lam la 'dzegs pa smos ci dgos/ /dam pa rnams las zab mo'i chos thos te/ /nges don snying po dam pas 'byor dus 'dir/ /thar pa'i lam la kha lo sgyur par mdzod/ /dal 'byor dbang po brtson pa'i yal 'dab can/ /pha rol phyin drug go mtshon bzang pos mdzes/ /thabs dang shes rab stobs chen rkang 'gros can/ / bsod nams ye shes dpung gis legs bskor te/ /nyon mongs dgra chen 'joms la brtson par mdzod/ /gang du thub pas zag pa med zhi ba/ /nyer bsten 'phags pa'i nor bdun ldan pa yis/ /zhi ba'i gnas su bsam gtan sgom par mdzod/ /sa dang lam rnams ma lus rab rdzogs nas/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i pha rol mchog tu 'gro/ /sdug bsngal shes bya kun 'byung rab spang phyir/ /lam nyid bsten pas 'gog pa thob par 'gyur/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs las ldog pa yis/ /srid pa'i grong las mya ngan 'das zhir 'gro/ /de phyir 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal shes byas te/ /de nyid spang phyir brtson pa'i stobs skyed cig /blo yi dbye bas theg pa gsum dag las/ /gang la mos pa'i byang chub bsgrub par bya/ /grogs dag khyed kyis theg mchog 'dir zhugs la/ /snying rje'i rang bzhin stong pa'i blo mnga' bas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che las sgrol bar mdzod/ /zag pa dang bcas pa sdug bsngal ba'i tshoms te gnyis pa'o// //sems nyid ma bcos pho brang chen po nas/ /dad ldan skye bo rnams la yang smras pa/

/'di ltar 'khor 'das snang zhing srid pa yi/ /chos rnams thams cad stong zhing bdag med de/ /ma bcos gnyug ma'i don gyi gnas lugs nyid/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gyis mtshon par bya/ /gzhi yi chos rnams snang stong mtha' bral te/ /mu bzhi las 'das gnyis snang bral bzhin du/ /snang tshul rkyen gyis cir yang snang ba de/ /bsdu na 'khor 'das gnyis snang chu zla'i tshul/ /dag dang ma dag rgyu 'bras rten 'brel tsam/ /las 'bras kun rdzob chos rnams sna tshogs snang*/ /de nyid ngor byas dge sdig blang dor byed/ /sa dang lam dang rnam dbye'i rnam pa can/ /glo bur dri bcas khams dang tshogs brgyad dang*/ /ting 'dzin gzungs sprin ye shes snying po can/ /so sor ma 'dres ji snyed mkhyen pa'i yul/ /de nyid gzigs pa rnams kyis legs par gsungs/ /snang de'i rang bzhin gdod nas ma skyes te/ /sgyu ma chu zla gnyis med sprul pa 'dra/ /dri za'i grong bzhin m-ig yor brag ca'i sgra/ /rmi lam smig rgyu'i rang bzhin snying po med/ /ji ltar snang zhing rdzun la dngos med de/ /ma skyes gdod nas dag par shes par bya/ /snang bzhin stong la stong bzhin snang ba ste/ /so so ma yin gcig min gnyis med min/ /de las gzhan min spros pa'i mtha' las 'das/ /rtog ge'i tshul min dbu ma'i rang bzhin ni/ /'di zhes mi mtshon spros pa kun dang bral/ /skye med 'gag med 'ong med 'gro ba med/ /rtag min chad m-in tha dad don gcig min/ /dus gsum dus med 'khor 'das stong pa'i tshul/ /don dam rten 'brel snang stong mtha' las 'das/ /grub pa'i mtha' stong khas len kun dang bral/ /dam bca' med cing tshogs chos rjes 'gros dben/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid du'ang rang bzhin med/ /bdag dang bdag med ma yin dpe las 'das/ /don dam gzigs pas ji bzhin legs par gsungs/ /de phyir gang snang de nyid spros las 'das/ /rang bzhin gnyis med gnyug ma'i gnas lugs nyid/

/gzhi yi chos su legs par mkhyen par mdzod/ /lam gyi chos la lta sgom spyod pa gsum/ /lta ba'i chos nyid mtha' dbus phyogs lhung bral/ /rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i gzhi de ni/ /rang gi legs smon sngon sbyangs bsod nams dang*/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs las legs rtogs te/ /mkha' la nyi shar mun nag sangs pa bzhin/ /yin min yid dpyod sgro 'dogs kun dang bral/ /gzhi nyid dngos po kun gyi gnas lugs te/ /de nyid blo yis legs rtogs lta ba yin/ /de yang gang shar snang stong chos nyid de/ /spang blang dgag sgrub re dogs med pa'i ngang*/ /ched 'dzin gza' gtad bral na rtogs pa yin/ /rtogs pa'i don dang dus kun ma bral bar/ /'dzin med rgyal po phyogs ris med pa na/ /yang rab dbang po lta thog nyid nas grol/ /gang shar rgyal po lhun rdzogs blo bde'o/ /mdor na gzhi nyid rtogs pa lta ba ste/ /yin min the tshom som nyi yid dpyod bral//blo yis ma bcos gnyen pos bcos mi dgos/ /gang snang nyid nas rang shar spros dang bral/ /bzo med rab babs rig pa skad cig ma/ /shugs 'byung rang grol zang thal lta ba'i don/ /phyi rabs rnal 'byor kun gyis mkhyen par mdzod/ /sgom pa'i don la rab 'bring tha ma gsum/ /yang rab sgom med lta thog nyid nas grol/ /bcos shing bsgyur med rang babs gnas pa yin/ /'bring rnams mnyam pa'i rang bzhin shes pas grol/ /thag pa'i rang bzhin shes pas sbrul 'jigs med/ /gang shar gzung 'dzin skad cig mtshang rig na/ /ma yengs dran pas spang gnyen kun las grol/ /gnyis med rang bzhin mnyam pa'i ngang gnas so/ /tha mas lus sems khong glod mnyam par bzhag

/ri bo rgya mtsho rig pa cog gzhag ngang*/ /sems nyid ma bcos gzung 'dzin bral bar bzhag /snga phyi'i dran bsam skyel bsu mi byed cing*/ /da ltar shes pa bzo med lhug par bzhag /dwangs la mi g.yo rgya mtsho lta bu dang*/ /yangs la mi rtog sprin med nam mkha' dang*/ /brtan la mi g.yo ri rgyal lta bur zhog /de ltar goms pas gnas pa'i ting 'dzin ni/ /phyi nang gzung 'dzin spros pa'i mtha' bral zhing*/ /ji tsam bzhag pa de tsam mnyam par gnas/ /de las mnyam zhing dang po'i ting 'dzin ni/ /rnam rtog zhi la gsal snang mi 'gag cing*/ /dwangs pa'i cha las mngon shes spyan rnams 'char/ /thams cad ma skyes nam mkha'i don du mthong*/ /de bas rang bzhin dag pa'i ting 'dzin ni/ /spyod lam kun tu mnyam gzhag mi g.yo zhing*/ /sna tshogs snang ba rmi lam sgyu mar rtogs/ /rang rig stong gsal mtha' dbus med pa dang*/ /nyon mongs rang grol dgag sgrub 'khrul pa zhig /bden med ngang nas gtad med chen por spyod/ /'di ltar rtogs te sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /stong nyid snying rje zung du 'brel ba yis/ /mtha' yas 'gro la phan pa dpag med 'grub/ /rjes snang rmi lam sgyu mar shes par bya/ /mdor na stong dang snying rje ma bral ba/ /rtogs pa'i ngang la gnas pa sgom par gsungs/ /phyi rabs rnal 'byor rnams kyis mkhyen par mdzod/ /spyod pa'i don yang 'di ltar rnam pa gsum/ /thun mong mchog dang bla na med pa'o/ /dang po thun mong spyod pa bstan pa ni/ /bstan pa'i sgor zhugs thos bsam rnam dag bya/ /mi dge dor zhing dge la brtson pa dang*/ /snying rje byang sems bslab gsum brtul zhugs bsrung*/ /mkhas shing des la nga rgyal med pa dang*/ /kun dang go bstun mtha' gcig mi gnas shing*/ /rang rgyud dul la blo sna thung ba dang*/ /kun dang mi mthun 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /tshe 'di'i che thabs bya bzhag brel ba bskyung*/ /kun las khyad 'phags rang spyod gtsang ba dang*/

/shes rab dri med tshig don kun la mkhas/ /gcig tu mi rtag 'chi chos bsgrub par mdzod/ /de ltar mdzad na 'di phyir bde ba thob/ /mchog gi spyod pa blang dor med pa yis/ /chos nyid don la sgyu ma'i rtsal sbyang zhing*/ /tshogs drug lhug pa ma bcos rnal ma la/ /'di zhes mi 'dzin blo yi mdud pa bor/ /phyogs ris ma spyod shugs 'byung zang ka ma/ /bu chung smyon pa rgan po'i ngang tshul can/ /ma bcos thog babs khong yangs blo bde 'o/ /chos nyid rnal ma ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang*/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa ma bcos gang shar bskyang*/ /gtad med gzung 'dzin bral ba'i rig pa la/ /'di zhes 'dzin pas ma bslad so mar zhog /gang babs rang byung shar grol 'dzin med la/ /rtog pa'i 'phro mthud ma byed yan du chug /ye grol cog gzhag rang grol chen po la/ /yid dpyod sgom pas ma bslad gang bder thong*/ /gnyis med sems kyi glang po yan pa la/ /dmigs gtad zhen pa'i lcags kyus ma 'debs shig/ji srid spang gnyen 'dzin pa'i sems yod par/ /grol ba'i thabs med 'khor ba de rang nyid/ /gang la 'dzin med gza' gtad bral ba na/ /de la chos med theg pa'i zhe 'dod med/ /rang byung lhun grub chen po'i dgongs par phyin/ /sgyu mar mi gnas sgyu mar spyad par bya/ /bla na med pa'i spyod pa chen po ni/ /dur khrod lung stong tshong 'dus la sogs su/ /mi gtsang ngo tsha rnam par bral ba yis/ /brtul zhugs spyod cing dgag sgrub steng du dbab//dug lnga ma spangs rang byung chen po'i ngang*/ /'di byas med pa'i spyod pa tshad gzung med/ /gang shar de spyod rang shar zang ka ma/ /rang bzhin smyon pa'i brtul shugs 'dzin pa yis/ /chos nyid don la sna tshogs rtsal sbyong bya/ /nyams dang dga' brod 'jigs pa'i thog rgyug gis/ /gang shar 'dzin med lta ba'i rtsal sbyang bya/ /kha ṭwāṃ rus pa'i rgyan rnams yongs rdzogs pas/ /dpa' bo'i chas brgyad mkha' 'gro smyon spyod bya/

/'dis ni mchog dang thun mong dngos grub brnyes/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /nad gdon mi mthun rkyen rnams rang sar grol/ /tshe 'di nyid la bde chen mkha' spyod 'gro/ /mdor na ma chags sgyu ma'i ngang tshul can/ /chos nyid ngang nas 'pho 'gyur med par sbyang*/ /phyi rabs rnal 'byor rnams kyis mkhyen par mdzod/ /gang gang blo yis btags pa'i chos rnams kun/ /rang rang ngo bos stong ste chu zla'i gzugs/ /snang snang 'dra yang rang bzhin med pas na/ /yang yang ma skyes sgyu ma'i rtsal sbyang mdzod/ /thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa'i tshoms te gsum pa'o// //gzhi rdzogs gnyug ma'i pho brang chen po nas/ /dad ldan skye bo rnams la yang smras pa/ /chos sku rgyal por gtan srid zin pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog tu zhi ba'i chos/ /gdod ma'i zad sa legs par mkhyen 'tshal lo/ /gzhi nyid lta sgom spyod pa mthar phyin nas/ /rang don chos sku gzhan don gzugs sku gnyis/ /nor bu bzhin du phrin las lhun gyis grub/ /de tshe mi rtog chos sku nam mkha' 'dra/ /bri med 'phel med zab zhi spros dang bral/ /de las gzugs sku nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /gdul bya'i snod dang 'tshams par chu zla bzhin/ /nges pa'i don lon nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ /ma dag 'gro dang sar gnas dag pa'i don/ /rang bzhin lhun grub bya rtsol med par 'byung*/ /srid pa ji srid phrin las rgyun mi 'chad/ /'di ni dus gsum rgyal ba'i rang bzhin te/ /'og min gnas su mngon par byang chub bo/ /gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis 'byor pa yi/ /gzhi lam de bzhin nyid kyi 'bras bu ni/ /phyi rabs rnal 'byor rnams kyis mkhyen par mdzod/ /mya ngan las 'das pa zhi ba'i tshoms te bzhi pa'o// //dri med 'od zer mkha' la shar ba yis/ /dad ldan skye bo'i pad tshal rgyas byas kyang*/ /da ni mi sdod nub ri'i rtser lhung bas/ /grogs dag nges 'byung blo sna thung bar mdzod/

/dge ba de yis srid pa'i 'gro ba kun/ /sdug bsngal chu gter brgal dka' rab bsgral te/ /sku dang ye shes 'du bral med pa'i gnas/ /bde chen sa la phyam gcig 'gro bar shog /sngon gyi chos rgyal dam pas bsten pa'i ri/ /gangs ri thod dkar o rgyan rdzong gnas su/ /chos kyi sdom bzhi'i dri med gtam 'di byas/ /dad ldan skye bo'i tshogs rnams dga' bar mdzod/ /chos kyi sdom bzhi dri ma med pa'i gtam zhes bya ba/ mang du thos pa'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul o rgyan rdzong zhes bya ba'i dben gnas su/ dpyid gsum bsir bu'i gnam g.yogs 'dzin pa'i tshe legs par sbyar ba yongs su rdzogs so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (24) chos kyi sdom bzhi ston pa dri ma med pa'i gtam/ -PAGE 206--PAGE 205--PAGE 192-
